The real problem

Your business probably doesn't have a lead problem. It has a conversion problem.

A prospect finds your business. They visit your website. They call, submit a form, or request a quote.

Then they wait.

Every minute without a response gives them another reason to call your competitor. CallDirector connects your website, phone, messaging, CRM, and follow-up into one automated system designed to move opportunities toward becoming customers.

Built by someone who's spent 22+ years keeping businesses reachable.

Most AI agencies started with chatbots. CallDirector started with the phone line. Our founder has spent more than two decades as a VoIP engineer, designing and supporting enterprise phone systems and making sure the right call reaches the right person.

About CallDirector →

Straight answers.

Will it sound like a robot?

Vera tells callers she is an AI assistant. We set her voice, script, and escalation rules with you, and you hear sample calls before anything goes live.

What if it is an emergency or a call she can’t handle?

We agree the rules with you up front: which calls go straight to a person, which take a message, and what Vera never answers on her own.

Do you text my customers?

Yes, with their consent. We register your business for compliant text messaging as part of setup, so replies land reliably instead of getting filtered by carriers as spam.

How long does setup take?

Most systems go live 2 to 3 weeks after kickoff, depending on how much of your current site and CRM we’re rebuilding versus building from scratch.

Is there a contract?

No long-term contract. The one-time implementation fee gets your system built and live, then the managed plan runs month-to-month. Cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice.
